schema:name.label: Title
schema:name.help: A name for the dataset that says what it is, where and when. For example: Zircon U-Pb ages, Rio Grande rift, 2019 to 2022.

schema:description.label: Description
schema:description.help: A few sentences on what the data are, how they were collected and what they can be used for. People read this to decide whether the dataset is what they need.

schema:identifier.label: Identifier (DOI)
schema:identifier.help: The dataset's permanent identifier, written as a full address such as https://doi.org/10.1234/abcd.

@type.label: Kind of resource
@type.help: Leave as Dataset unless you are describing something else, such as software or a document.

schema:datePublished.label: Date published
schema:datePublished.help: When the dataset was first made available.

schema:dateModified.label: Date last updated
schema:dateModified.help: When the data were last changed. Use the publication date if they have not changed since.

schema:version.label: Version
schema:version.help: The version of the dataset, if it has one. For example: 2.1.

schema:inLanguage.label: Language
schema:inLanguage.help: The language of the data, as a short code. For example: en.

schema:additionalType.label: More specific kinds
schema:additionalType.help: Optional. More precise terms for what this is, such as observational data or model output.

schema:keywords.label: Keywords
schema:keywords.help: Words or short phrases people might search for. Add each one separately.

schema:sameAs.label: Other identifiers
schema:sameAs.help: Other addresses or identifiers for the same dataset, such as a second DOI or a repository's own number.

schema:creator/@list.label: Authors
schema:creator/@list.help: The people and organisations who created the dataset, in the order they should be cited.

schema:creator/@list/schema:name.label: Name
schema:creator/@list/schema:name.help: For a person: family name, given name.

schema:creator/@list/schema:identifier.label: ORCID iD or other identifier
schema:creator/@list/schema:identifier.help: Written as a full address, such as https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097.

schema:creator/@list/schema:affiliation/.label: Organisation
schema:creator/@list/schema:affiliation/.help: Where the author worked when the data were created.

schema:contributor.label: Contributors
schema:contributor.help: People and organisations who helped but are not authors, each with what they did.

schema:contributor/schema:roleName.label: What they did
schema:contributor/schema:roleName.help: For example: data curator, field assistant, reviewer.

schema:publisher/schema:name.label: Publisher
schema:publisher/schema:name.help: The organisation that makes the dataset available, usually the repository that holds it.

schema:publisher/schema:identifier.label: Publisher's identifier
schema:publisher/schema:identifier.help: Filled in when you choose a publisher from the list.

schema:provider.label: Data providers
schema:provider.help: Organisations or people who supply the data files, if different from the publisher.

schema:funding.label: Grants
schema:funding.help: The grants or awards that paid for the work.

schema:funding/schema:funder/schema:name.label: Funder
schema:funding/schema:funder/schema:name.help: The organisation that awarded the grant.

schema:funding/schema:identifier.label: Grant number
schema:funding/schema:identifier.help: The award number the funder gave the grant.

schema:funding/schema:identifier/schema:.label: Web address
schema:funding/schema:identifier/schema:.help: The funder's page for the grant, if there is one.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.label: How the data were produced
prov:wasGeneratedBy.help: Optional. The activity that produced the data, such as a cruise, a survey or a model run.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.label: Derived from
prov:wasDerivedFrom.help: Optional. Other datasets this one was made from. Give each as an address or a citation.

schema:url.label: Landing page
schema:url.help: The web page that describes the dataset and leads to the data. Give this, or at least one download below.

schema:license.label: Licence
schema:license.help: The terms under which others may use the data. For example: CC BY 4.0, with the address of the licence text.

schema:conditionsOfAccess.label: Conditions of access
schema:conditionsOfAccess.help: Anything that limits who can get the data or when, such as an embargo or a registration step.

schema:distribution.label: Downloads and services
schema:distribution.help: Each file that can be downloaded, or web service that gives access to the data.

schema:relatedLink.label: Related links
schema:relatedLink.help: Papers, documentation, software or other datasets connected to this one.

schema:relatedLink/schema:linkRelationsh.label: How it is related
schema:relatedLink/schema:linkRelationsh.help: For example: documentation, described in, source code.

schema:publishingPrinciples.label: Publishing policies
schema:publishingPrinciples.help: Optional. Policies the dataset was published under, such as a repository's data policy.

schema:spatialCoverage.label: Where the data are from
schema:spatialCoverage.help: The place or area the data describe. Give a place name, a bounding box, or both.

schema:spatialCoverage/schema:geo/schema.label: Bounding box
schema:spatialCoverage/schema:geo/schema.help: Four numbers in decimal degrees: south, west, north, east. For example: 53.0 -60.0 65.0 -45.0.

schema:temporalCoverage.label: Time covered
schema:temporalCoverage.help: The period the data describe, as two dates separated by a slash. For example: 2015-02-01/2024-03-31.

schema:variableMeasured.label: Variables
schema:variableMeasured.help: What was measured or recorded: one entry for each column or quantity in the data.

schema:variableMeasured/schema:name.label: Name
schema:variableMeasured/schema:name.help: The variable's name as it appears in the data.

schema:variableMeasured/schema:descripti.label: Description
schema:variableMeasured/schema:descripti.help: A sentence saying what the variable holds.

dqv:hasQualityMeasurement.label: Quality measurements
dqv:hasQualityMeasurement.help: Optional. Measured statements about data quality, such as sensor accuracy or completeness.

schema:subjectOf/schema:maintainer.label: Who maintains this description
schema:subjectOf/schema:maintainer.help: The person or organisation to contact about this record, as opposed to the data.

schema:subjectOf/schema:sdDatePublished.label: Date this description was published
schema:subjectOf/schema:sdDatePublished.help: Leave empty to use today's date.

schema:subjectOf/schema:includedInDataCa.label: Source catalog
schema:subjectOf/schema:includedInDataCa.help: Optional. The catalog this description first appeared in, if it was copied from one.
